scope: Known-map CPU predictions of how each queued tree1 target of the seeded registers ends under the baseline straight path, made before any of them ran. Never a filter: every registered target runs and is reported. Built from URDF kinematics, the robot's convex link hulls (the PhysX collision shapes), the exported orchard meshes and the recorded settled home pose; the replay step k corresponds to recorded frames k+1 to k+4.

marginal_home: a link hull within 2 mm of orchard geometry at home
hazard_contact / tof_minimum_clearance: the earliest event on the straight path, at replay step k (recorded frame k+1..k+5)
